checkpoints.note: info.rle is true (TGA_TYPE_RLE_INDEXED/RGB/GREY), entering the RLE decode path where the vulnerable raw-packet branch lives
Reads raw pixel data from the attacker-controlled stream into the image buffer. When the stream is truncated, readRawData returns fewer bytes than count, leaving part of the buffer uninitialized.

The return value of readRawData (number of bytes actually read) is discarded. No check for short read and no memset to zero-fill the unread portion of the buffer. The fix captures the return value and zero-fills any unread portion.
